fixes.reason: Filed under Cabanglasan; Ignacio Zubiri was mayor of Malaybalay City (he won it again in 2016).
Filed under Talakag; Leandro Jose Catarata was mayor of Valencia City (also in 2007).
Filed under Talakag; Jose Galario Jr. was mayor of Valencia City (also in 2001 and 2004).
Filed under Cabanglasan; Victor Aldeguer was a Malaybalay City official.
Two vice mayors are filed under Cabanglasan for 2013; Lolita "Lotlot" Obsioma later served as Cabanglasan mayor (2022).
Two vice mayors are filed under Cabanglasan for 2013; the other one, Lolita Obsioma, is from Cabanglasan.
Filed under Talakag; Azucena Huervas was later mayor of Valencia City (2016–2025).
Two vice mayors are filed under Talakag for 2013; Vergito Factura was later mayor of Talakag (2016–2025).
No municipality in the source; Don Carlos has no other 2004 vice mayor, and Ma. Victoria Ontanillas Pizarro was Don Carlos mayor in 2007.
No municipality in the source; Malitbog has no other 2013 vice mayor, and Gary Casiño was later Malitbog mayor (2022–2025).
Kadingilan 2013 is missing from the source. MindaNews reports that independent Jerry Canoy Sr. won over incumbent Mayor Talaid. Source: https://mindanews.com/?p=46046
Some municipal winners have no city or municipality in Open Halalan, mostly Malitbog. Each winner is placed by where they held office in other years.

Open Halalan files the 2010 and 2013 Valencia City winners under Talakag (two mayors and two vice mayors per year, and no Valencia rows). Each winner is placed by where they held office in other years.

Open Halalan files the 2010 and 2013 Malaybalay City winners under Cabanglasan (two mayors and two vice mayors per year, and no Malaybalay rows). Each winner is placed by where they held office in other years.

people.name: Maria Lourdes "Malou" Acosta-Alba
people.mergeNote: Editors' match: the 1st district representative elected in 2013 as "Maria Isidro Acosta" and in 2016 and 2019 as "Malou Acosta" is Maria Lourdes Acosta-Alba, who left the seat in 2022 (MindaNews 2022-05-10).

people.name: Juan Romeo Nereus "Neric" O. Acosta
people.mergeNote: "J.R. Nereus O. Acosta" (2001) and "Juan Romeo Nereus Acosta" (2004) are the same 1st district representative, Neric Acosta.

people.name: Jose Manuel "Joeman" Alba
people.mergeNote: "Joeman" is the ballot name of 1st district representative Jose Manuel Alba (MindaNews 2022-05-10).

people.name: Pedro "Adong" Alvarez
people.mergeNote: Same seat (Baungon mayor) and same middle name, Roa; "Adong" is the ballot nickname.

people.name: Reynaldo "Jimboy" Ang Rabanes
people.mergeNote: Same seat (Kibawe mayor) and same middle name, Sio; "Jimboy" is the ballot nickname.

people.name: Leonardo Genesis T. Calingasan
people.mergeNote: "Leonardo Genesis T.", "Leonardo G. Tejano" and "Leonardo Tejano" Calingasan are the same Libona official (councilor 2001–2010, mayor 2010–2019).

people.name: Fruto "Dodong" Dandasan
people.mergeNote: Same seat (Dangcagan mayor) and same middle name, Buchorno; "Dodong" is the ballot nickname.

people.name: Mark Vincent "Makoy" Dandasan
people.mergeNote: Same seat (Dangcagan mayor), consecutive terms; "Makoy" is the ballot nickname.

people.name: Catherine "Cathy" B. dela Rosa
people.mergeNote: Same middle name (Bandialan) and municipality (Malitbog); "Cathy" is the ballot nickname.

people.name: Osmundo "Munding" dela Rosa
people.mergeNote: Same seat (Malitbog mayor); "Munding" is the ballot nickname.

people.name: Levi C. Edma Sr.
people.mergeNote: "Levi Cañete Edma" and "Levi Edma Sr." are the same San Fernando mayor; MindaNews (2016-05-10) reports "the reelection of Mayor Levi Edma Sr." Kept apart from his son Levi Edma Jr.

people.name: Florencio "Docboy" T. Flores Jr.
people.mergeNote: "Docboy Tadiar Flores", elected Malaybalay mayor in 2019, is Florencio Tadiar Flores Jr.: the mayor who died in office in 2022, whose son Rep. Jonathan Keith Flores is "son of the late former Malaybalay mayor Florencio Flores Jr." (MindaNews 2022-05-10; PCIJ 2025-05-22).

people.name: Jonathan Keith "John" T. Flores
people.mergeNote: "John Tello Flores" on the ballot; 2nd district representative Jonathan Keith Flores (MindaNews 2022-05-10; PCIJ 2025-05-22).

people.name: Grezil "Cecil" G. Galario-Fernandez
people.mergeNote: "Cecil Galario" on the ballot; Valencia City vice mayor from 2025 (MindaNews 2025-05-13; PCIJ 2025-05-22).

people.name: Renante "Dodong" Inocando
people.mergeNote: Same seat (Cabanglasan mayor) and same middle name, Valdez; "Dodong" is the ballot nickname.

people.name: Poling Lorenzo
people.mergeNote: Quezon mayor 2019–2025; the 2022 ballot adds "III". Treated as one person.

people.name: Jose "Joe" Obedencio
people.mergeNote: Same seat (Maramag mayor) and same middle name, Vallejera.

people.name: Lolita "Lotlot" Obsioma
people.mergeNote: Same municipality (Cabanglasan) and same middle name, Nellas; "Lotlot" is the ballot nickname.

people.name: Jay Warren R. Pabillaran
people.mergeNote: Same person: MindaNews names "lawyer Jay Warren Pabillaran" as the top Malaybalay councilor in 2010 and 2013, and as the mayor who won as vice mayor in 2019. Same middle name, Ramos; the source lists him as "Warren" from 2016.

mergeSources.title: Lumad families dominate Malaybalay's city council
mergeSources.quote: The number one councilor, lawyer Jay Warren Pabillaran, who garnered 36,559 votes... Pabillaran also topped the winners for city councilor in the 2010 elections.

mergeSources.title: Malaybalay City mayor paces lone rival
mergeSources.quote: Pabillaran won as vice mayor in 2019.

people.name: Alona O. Pizarro
people.mergeNote: Same seat (Don Carlos mayor), consecutive terms; the 2022 row gives the middle name as "Victoria", the 2019 and 2025 rows as "Ontanillas".

people.name: Laarni Lavin-Roque
people.mergeNote: Valencia City councilor (2019) and 4th district representative (2022, 2025) are the same person, Laarni Lavin-Roque (MindaNews 2022-05-10). The 2025 row gives her middle name as Pepito, which is her husband's.

people.name: Rogelio Neil "Oneil" P. Roque
people.mergeNote: "Oneil" is the ballot name of Rogelio Neil Pepito Roque, 4th district representative (2013–2022) and governor from 2022 (MindaNews 2022; PCIJ 2025).

people.name: Anthony "Cheche" A. Uy
people.mergeNote: Same middle name (Antivo) and seat. MindaNews (2025-05-13) says Anthony Uy "won as mayor in 2016 and was reelected in 2019 and 2022", the terms filed as "Cheche Antivo Uy".

people.name: Audrey Kay "Inday" T. Zubiri
people.mergeNote: Filed as "Inday Lucasan Zubiri". PCIJ (2025-05-22): "Audrey Zubiri, wife of Sen. Juan Miguel Zubiri, won by a landslide in the third district congressional race."

people.name: Jose Maria "Joey" Zubiri III
people.mergeNote: These representative rows carry the same name as the governor, who was serving as governor at the time. MindaNews (2016-05-10) says Manuel Zubiri "will replace his brother, Joey Zubiri, who is on his third term" in the 3rd district.

people.name: Jose Maria R. Zubiri Jr.
people.mergeNote: The source spells his name five ways ("Jose Ma. Jr. R.", "Jose Ma. Maria", "Jose Maria", "Jose Rubin", "Jose Maria Jr.") and uses "Jose Ma. Maria" for his son as well. Governor 2001–2010 and 2013–2022, vice governor 2010–2013 and 3rd district representative from 2022 (MindaNews 2016-05-10, 2022-05-10).
